meta.name: Buffy the Vampire Slayer: Pangs
meta.description:
Buffy the Vampire Slayer · Season 4, Episode 8 · aired 1999-11-23

On Thanksgiving, Buffy encounters the spirit of a Native American warrior whose people were wiped out by settlers. Meanwhile Angel silently returns to Sunnydale after Doyle's vision of Buffy in danger.
